description: Saves the current global word into a table slot selected by its value, clears the global word and a frame control field, and returns the saved value.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:044A
name: store_counter_after_call
description: Calls a routine, sets a control field in the frame, saves the global word into a table slot selected by its value, clears the global word and returns zero.

name: write_parameter_block_and_run
description: Writes a sequence of argument values into a set of global words, selects one of two fixed table entries by a flag argument, and calls a routine. If a status bit is clear or the selected entry is negative, it makes two more calls.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:04CE
name: step_position_to_target
description: Compares a global position with a stored position and steps toward it one unit at a time, calling a routine for each step in the direction of motion. It then stores the new position and waits while the status bits stay set.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:04D2
name: step_position_toward_stored_value
description: Runs the same stepping loop as its neighbour without the leading call: it steps a global position toward a stored value one unit at a time, calling a routine per step, then stores the new position and waits on status bits.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:04E6
name: repeat_routine_then_store_position
description: Calls a routine a number of times given by a register, stores the global position in a frame word, then waits while status bits stay set.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:04F4
name: clear_position_after_wait
description: While a status bit is set it calls two routines. It then clears a frame word, stores nothing else and waits on status bits.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:04F6
name: loop_on_flag_then_clear
description: Repeats two routine calls while a status bit stays set, then clears a frame word and waits on status bits.

name: set_control_code_one
description: Replaces the low control bits of a global with a code of one, calls a routine, then waits while status bits stay set.

name: set_control_code_three
description: Replaces the low control bits of a global with a code of three, calls a routine, then waits while status bits stay set. The record lists access to a CIA-B port register.

name: set_timer_and_poll_bit
description: Clears one bit of a control word chosen by a two-bit selector, writes three timing values, then calls a routine repeatedly until it returns nonzero. The record lists CIA-B port and timer registers.

name: load_timer_values_and_poll
description: Writes the values 80, 9 and 25 to global control words, then calls a routine repeatedly until it returns nonzero. The record lists CIA-B control and timer registers.

name: wait_on_status_bits
description: Waits on two status bits in a global and returns once the first bit is clear. The record lists access to the CIA-A port register.

name: install_interrupt_handler_enable
description: Calls an object method four times, storing each returned value in a global table, then installs a routine as the handler and writes interrupt control values that enable the chosen bits. Writes with the top bit set enable the named interrupt bits.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:07A0
name: bracket_method_call_ten
description: Makes a system trap call, calls an object method at a fixed table offset of ten, then makes a second system trap call.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:07BC
name: bracket_method_call_offset_136
description: Makes a system trap call, calls an object method at a fixed table offset of 136, then makes a second system trap call.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:07D8
name: decode_keyboard_key_state
description: Reads the keyboard serial byte, decodes it by inverting and rotating it into a key code, and updates a key-state bitmap in a global after matching it against a short table of recent codes. Codes at or above a threshold are passed to a linked-list walk instead, and the routine finishes by waiting on a handshake and clearing a bit; the referenced text is a string of printable characters.

name: clear_bit_wait_then_restore
description: Clears one bit of a global selected by the low three bits of a data register, polls a routine until it returns nonzero, then clears bit six of the same global.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:083C
name: walk_nodes_then_wait_clear
description: Walks a linked list from a global head, calling a method at offset 16 on each node. It then polls a routine until it returns nonzero and clears bit six of a global.

name: walk_chain_from_register
description: Calls a method at offset 16 on successive list nodes, starting from a node in a register, until the link is zero. It then polls a routine until it returns nonzero and clears bit six of a global.

name: translate_key_code_with_shift
description: Looks up a key code in one of two character tables chosen by modifier bits in the code, and for letters applies a case rule based on the shift state. The referenced text lists the number row and symbol keys, unshifted and shifted.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:08C6
name: return_empty_stub_sixth
description: Returns immediately with no work.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:08F2
name: poll_joystick_and_mouse_ports
description: Writes a value to the pot control register, reads a joystick and mouse port value into a global, and calls one of two routines depending on the value. It returns zero.

name: store_deltas_call_method
description: Stores the byte difference of two inputs, a derived high-byte value and a third value into global words, then calls an object method at offset 50.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:09AA
name: load_indexed_value_call_method
description: Loads a long from a global table selected by two bit fields of a data register, stores it in a global with a second value, then calls an object method at offset 50.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:0A68
name: set_two_bracket_method_call
description: Sets a global to two, makes a system trap call, calls an object method at offset ten, then makes a second system trap call.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:0AE0
name: setup_interrupt_object_and_enable
description: Calls a sequence of object methods to build a structure, sets two flag bits in one of its fields, and calls a routine. It then writes interrupt control and DMA values, where writes with the top bit set enable the named bits; the record notes calls to an empty stub.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:0C06
name: set_control_word_nine
description: Sets a global word to 32768 and then to nine. The record lists access to the CIA-A control register B.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:0C18
name: access_ciaa_control_register_b
description: The decompiler timed out on this 72-instruction routine, so no pseudo-code is available. The record shows it accesses the CIA-A control register B and that one routine calls it, and its behaviour is not recovered.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:0D68

description: Adds one to a global counter and returns.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:0D6E
name: decrement_global_counter
description: Subtracts one from a global counter. A following test that needs the counter to be both zero and nonzero can never succeed, so no reset takes effect; the record lists access to the CIA-A control register B.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:0D84
name: stop_while_flag_then_check
description: Halts the processor with a stop instruction while bit six of a global is set. It then runs a test that can never succeed, so the routine leaves the global unchanged.

key: runtime segment $004020-$009290:0:0D8A
name: wait_bit_then_decrement_counter
description: Halts the processor in a loop while bit six of a global is set, then decrements the global counter. The reset to nine after a zero result can never run; the record lists the CIA-A control register B and the DMA control read register.
